infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Shiki sends your photos and files to Shiki on your PC over your Wi-Fi.

plugins.cameraPermission: Shiki uses the camera only to scan the code on your PC.

plugins.photosPermission: Shiki sends the photos and videos you choose (or ask for from your PC) to your PC.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Shiki saves photos and videos your PC sends you into Photos.

plugins.photosPermission: Shiki sends the photos and videos you pick to your PC.
